scope: Rainfall-driven flood labels and event history for Male island proper
conclusion: No public street-level geocoded multi-event flood/dry training inventory was verified. Official incident tables, aggregate statistics and reports can seed an event catalogue, while detailed local observation records remain a data request.

rows.name: NDMA Male City incident table
rows.access_status: Public page verified through web retrieval; no CSV link or coordinate fields shown
rows.coverage: A visible rainwater entry is dated 2023-10-01; the page also lists other hazards and other Greater Male islands
rows.grain: Incident record with location text and date, not a comprehensive event footprint
rows.use: Seed event catalogue and trace the agency record
rows.limitation: One visible rainwater record is insufficient; no observed dry examples; exact household/location text should be restricted or aggregated in outputs
rows.recommended_action: Request complete rainwater-flood event inventory for Male proper with geocodable locations, event times, flood verification and observation coverage

rows.name: DALA downloadable disaster statistics
rows.access_status: Page and public frontend verified; CSV bytes not obtained. Official frontend requests https://dala-api.ndma.gov.mv/api/public/downloads and downloads /api/public/downloads/{id}?year={year}; API returned HTTP 403 in this environment
rows.coverage: Year-selectable aggregates; indexed examples include monthly timelines, type counts, affected islands, atoll totals and demographic/financial aggregates
rows.grain: Monthly/island/atoll aggregate, not a per-location inundation label
rows.use: Background statistics, event context and reporting trends
rows.limitation: Advertised downloads must not be presented as successfully fetched data; aggregate counts cannot train a street flood classifier
rows.recommended_action: Try the normal public CSV buttons manually or ask NDMA for an approved aggregate export; separately request de-identified event-location observations

rows.name: NDMA Disaster Statistics of Maldives 2024
rows.access_status: Full report readable by web retrieval; direct local byte download returned HTTP 403
rows.coverage: December 2023 to December 2024; national, atoll and island statistics; Greater Male summary
rows.use: Context and verification of reporting definitions
rows.limitation: Greater Male differs from Male island proper; reported incidents differ from affected households; no street geocoding or verified dry observations
rows.recommended_action: Request the underlying non-identifying event register, with island code and event-date definitions

rows.name: Male City Council Voluntary Local Review 2025
rows.access_status: Report verified through web retrieval; direct local PDF download returned HTTP 403
rows.coverage: City background, 2019-2024 major hazard summary and 2023-2024 affected-person/household aggregates
rows.grain: City/ward summary and selected event dates
rows.use: Strong local rationale; identifies 8 major surface-water flood events for 2019-2024, with selected dates and ward-level drainage issues
rows.limitation: Not a geospatial training inventory; definitions and station attribution must be reconciled with primary records
rows.recommended_action: Ask Council for the underlying Draft Male City Disaster Management Plan 2025 event and hazard maps cited by the VLR

rows.name: MMS Severe Weather Report 2024
rows.format: Indexed official report; current URL redirects to MMS homepage
rows.access_status: Official indexed contents verified; current direct report delivery not verified
rows.coverage: Severe weather events during 2024, including 12-13 January
rows.grain: Weather-event summary and station rainfall; flood counts from NDMA
rows.use: Identify event windows and pair them to local rainfall observations
rows.limitation: No published street-by-street labels. Indexed report distinguishes Male AWS from Hulhule and Hulhumale stations; Council summary appears to mix station rainfall values
rows.recommended_action: Request current report copy and event observation files from MMS; verify UTC/local time and the rainfall accumulation period

rows.name: Global Flood Database v1
rows.access_status: Public catalogue verified; exact Male event coverage not verified
rows.coverage: 913 mapped global events, 2000-2018; effective MODIS flood observations at 250 m
rows.use: Regional context only if an overlapping event is found
rows.limitation: Do not infer actual 30 m flood detail from catalogue band spacing; 250 m effective observations are unsuitable as unquestioned street-level Male waterlogging truth
rows.recommended_action: Check AOI/event intersections before using; do not use as the primary local training labels

rows.name: JRC Global River Flood Hazard Maps v2.1
rows.coverage: River basins; explicitly excludes small islands with basins smaller than 500 square kilometres
rows.grain: Modelled river inundation at return periods
rows.limitation: Wrong flood mechanism and documented coverage exclusions; not observed local floods
rows.recommended_action: Do not use for this project's supervised labels
